name: Embercore
mods: Element(Flame); Style(Bolt); ApplyStatus(status: Burn, chance: 0.35, stacks: 1, duration: 3.0)
desc: Fire bolts that set the horde alight.

name: Stormcore
desc: Chain arcs leap between the damned.

name: Voidcore
mods: Element(Void); Style(Orb); GravityWell(radius: 2.2, pull: 5.0, duration: 1.5, dps: 0.25)
desc: Impacts open gravity wells that drag enemies together.

name: Plaguecore
mods: Element(Plague); Style(Globe); Puddle(radius: 1.8, duration: 3.5, dps: 0.35); ProjectileSpeed(0.8)
desc: Slow globes that burst into festering pools.

name: Dawncore
mods: Element(Radiant); Style(Shard); ApplyStatus(status: Mark, chance: 0.25, stacks: 1, duration: 4.0); CritDamage(0.3)
desc: Judgement shards that mark the guilty.

name: Ironcore
desc: Honest metal. Goes through the first one.

name: Ricochet
desc: Shots bounce to a new target after every hit.

name: Multishot
desc: Two more projectiles per shot.

name: Homing Shards
desc: Projectiles hunt their own targets.

name: Beam Sweep
desc: Converts the weapon into a sweeping beam.

name: Bounce-Fork
desc: On first hit the shot splits into two forks.

name: Sawblade Orbit
desc: Three forge-sawblades orbit you and shred anything close.

name: Lancet Drive
desc: Shots pierce three enemies and fly faster.

name: Scatterburst
desc: A wide fan of five projectiles at close range.

name: Overclock
desc: Faster. Hotter. Slightly less precise.

name: Vampire
desc: Return 4% of damage dealt as health.

name: Splitspawn
desc: Critical hits can spawn a short-lived turret.

name: Doomstack
desc: Every hit stacks doom; eight stacks burst for heavy damage.

name: Frostwake
desc: Projectiles leave chilling trails that slow the horde.

name: Volatile Heart
desc: Kills sometimes detonate.

name: Greedstone
desc: Godshards fall like rain. Better parts too.

name: Executioner's Seal
desc: Hits kill non-boss enemies below 12% health.

name: Nyctian Eye
desc: See the weak point. Hit it.

name: Bloodletter
desc: Hits open wounds that bleed harder while enemies run.

name: Giantsbane
desc: +35% damage against elites and bosses.

name: Sigil of the Anvilheart
desc: Gaiaa's stone beats in your chest.

name: Sigil of the Quaking Step
desc: Every dash lands like an earthquake.

name: Sigil of the Colossal Echo
desc: Ults leave burning ground.

name: Sigil of Cadence
desc: Every 4th shot echoes.

name: Sigil of Static Bloom
desc: Hits build shock that discharges in bursts.

name: Sigil of the Skyrender
desc: The storm never waits.

name: Sigil of Nightfall
desc: Nyctia guides the killing blow.

name: Sigil of the Silent Edge
desc: The wounded simply stop.

name: Sigil of Ghostlight
desc: One more step between worlds.

name: Sigil of Hexlace
desc: Every hit laces a curse.

name: Sigil of Tinker's Grace
desc: Your contraptions are always ready.

name: Sigil of Bound Souls
desc: Where your shots land the ground itself curses.

name: Sigil of the Furnace Heart
desc: Everything you touch catches.

name: Sigil of the Iron Knuckle
desc: Hit them so hard they remember it next run.

name: Sigil of Meltpoint
desc: +25% damage to burning enemies.

name: Sigil of the Huntmark
desc: The hunt-god chooses your quarry.

name: Sigil of Far Sight
desc: See further. Strike sooner.

name: Sigil of Patient Death
desc: The first hit is the one that matters.

name: Sigil of the Gilded Tongue
desc: Fortune listens when you talk.

name: Sigil of the Pickpocket
desc: The dead don't need godshards.

name: Sigil of Loaded Dice
desc: Fate owes you one.

name: Sigil of the Borrowed Hour
desc: Time runs faster for you.

name: Sigil of Slow Rot
desc: Your shots age the world they pass through.

name: Sigil of the Second Hand
desc: Every 5th shot happens twice.

name: Shrapnelcore
mods: Element(Kinetic); Style(Pellet); Fork(count: 3, angle: 70.0, damage: 0.35); Damage(0.95)
desc: On first hit every shot bursts into three shards of dead-god iron.

name: Barbcore
mods: Element(Kinetic); Style(Needle); ApplyStatus(status: Bleed, chance: 0.4, stacks: 1, duration: 4.0); Damage(0.9)
desc: Barbed needles that catch and tear. Running only makes it worse.

name: Cairncore
mods: Element(Kinetic); Style(Boulder); ApplyStatus(status: Root, chance: 0.2, stacks: 1, duration: 1.5); Damage(1.2); FireRate(0.85)
desc: Hurls grave-cairn stones that pin the living to the earth.

name: Slagcore
desc: Molten slag that bursts where it lands. The Slag King's leftovers.

name: Kilncore
mods: Element(Flame); Style(Globe); Puddle(radius: 1.6, duration: 3.0, dps: 0.3, status: Burn); ProjectileSpeed(0.85)
desc: Globes of liquid forge-fire that pool and keep on burning.

name: Wickcore
mods: Element(Flame); Style(Needle); Trail(duration: 3.0, dps: 0.3, slow: 0.0); Damage(0.9)
desc: Every shot drags a burning fuse behind it. The floor remembers.

name: Tempestcore
mods: Element(Storm); Style(Bolt); ApplyStatus(status: Shock, chance: 0.4, stacks: 1, duration: 2.5); ProjectileSpeed(1.25)
desc: Fast bolts that fill the damned with static until they burst.

name: Squallcore
mods: Element(Storm); Style(Arc); Fork(count: 2, angle: 45.0, damage: 0.55); Knockback(1.3)
desc: Lightning that splits the moment it finds flesh.

name: Hexcore
mods: Element(Void); Style(Needle); ApplyStatus(status: Curse, chance: 0.35, stacks: 1, duration: 4.0); Damage(0.9)
desc: Hex-needles that make the damned more damnable.

name: Gloamcore
desc: Dusk-blades that pass through the living as if they were already ghosts.

name: Blightcore
mods: Element(Plague); Style(Globe); Chain(jumps: 3, range: 3.0, falloff: 0.5); ProjectileSpeed(0.9)
desc: Sickness that leaps from body to body. Nobody is patient zero twice.

name: Miasmacore
mods: Element(Plague); Style(Globe); Trail(duration: 3.0, dps: 0.2, slow: 0.3); Range(1.15)
desc: Globes that weep a slowing fog behind them.

name: Gildcore
desc: Blessed gold. It always finds its way back into circulation.

name: Halocore
desc: Small haloes that go looking for the guilty.

name: Twin Barrel
desc: A second barrel, welded on by a smith who hated waiting.

name: Hydra Volley
desc: Three more heads on every shot. Each one bites.

name: Compass Rose
desc: Every shot erupts in a full circle, pointing everywhere at once.

name: Skipstone
desc: Quick shots that skip once off the first thing they hit.

name: Ricochet Rosary
desc: Three bounces per shot, a prayer bead for each.

name: Seeker Swarm
desc: Shots scatter wide, then turn and hunt.

name: Carrion Drift
desc: Slow shots that circle like crows until they find meat.

name: Railspike
desc: Hypervelocity spikes. Slow to load, impossible to dodge.

name: Impaler
desc: Skewers four in a row. Knockback all but vanishes, so the line holds still.

name: Cleaving Fork
desc: On first hit the shot cleaves into three.

name: Tuning Fork
desc: Two narrow tines ring on through the line at near-full strength.

name: Arc Relay
desc: A conductor coil: every hit arcs on to two more.

name: Needle Ray
desc: Converts the weapon into a thin, far-reaching ray.

name: Titan's Exhale
desc: Converts the weapon into a short, wide gout of force.

name: Whirling Anvils
desc: Two anvils swing around you on chains of light. They are heavy. So are you.

name: Razor Halo
desc: Five razors spin tight around you. Hugging you is now a mistake.

name: Gatling Hymn
desc: A hymn with one very fast verse.

name: Heavy Hand
desc: Fewer shots. Each lands like a verdict, and every blast grows to match.

name: Quickdraw String
desc: Charge weapons draw in half the time. Everything else just shoots a little faster.

name: Deep Draw
desc: Hold longer. Hit harder. Go through.

name: Resounding Vault
desc: Every third shot rings out twice.

name: Choke Bore
desc: Tightens every spread and sends it further.

name: Sundering Payload
desc: Every shot carries a charge of godfire that bursts on impact.

name: Coal-Tongue Brand
desc: Rarely catches. When it does, it catches twice.

name: Stormglass Phial
desc: Bottled thunder. Hits build static that discharges in bursts.

name: Hexnail
desc: A coffin nail. Every hit drives the curse a little deeper.

name: Rootbinder's Knot
mods: ApplyStatus(status: Root, chance: 0.15, stacks: 1, duration: 2.0); Knockback(0.6)
desc: Hits can bind enemies to the ground. Knockback softens so they stay put.

name: Quarry Brand
mods: ApplyStatus(status: Mark, chance: 0.35, stacks: 1, duration: 4.0); CritDamage(0.15)
desc: Brands your quarry. Hits against the Marked find the weak point.

name: Ashen Covenant
desc: +35% damage to burning enemies. Pyra keeps her promises.

name: Stormcatcher
desc: +35% damage to shocked enemies. The storm always knows where to go.

name: Ledger of Sins
desc: +30% damage to cursed enemies. Every sin is itemised.

name: Pinning Stake
desc: +50% damage to rooted enemies. Hold still, this will only hurt a lot.

name: Salt the Wound
desc: +25% damage to bleeding enemies, and a sip of whatever spills.

name: Scale of Judgement
desc: +35% damage to Marked enemies. The scale only ever tips one way.

name: Leech Crown
desc: Drink deep: 6% lifesteal, but you take 12% more damage.

name: Ichor Chalice
desc: A cup of god-blood. +30 max health and a steady trickle of healing.

name: Hound-9's Spare Parts
desc: Crits often spawn tiny, short-lived turrets. Hound-9 would like them back.

name: Sentry Seed
desc: Crits rarely plant a sturdy forge-sentry that fights on for six seconds.

name: Funeral Bell
desc: Every fifth hit tolls the bell. Small bursts, but it never stops ringing.

name: Epitaph Engine
desc: Twelve hits write the epitaph. The last one reads it aloud.

name: Pyre Lung
desc: Half of all kills cough out a small, hot burst.

name: Dying Star
desc: Now and then a kill collapses into a dying star and takes the whole crowd with it.

name: Reaper's Tithe
desc: Finishes enemies below 8% health and takes a godshard for the trouble.

name: Misericorde
desc: The mercy blade ends anything below 15% health. It hates starting fights.

name: Anvil Plate
desc: Take 15% less damage. Move like you are wearing an anvil, because you are.

name: Gilded Aegis
desc: A regenerating shield of beaten god-gold.

name: Beating Stone
desc: +50 max health and slow regeneration. It beats when you forget to.

name: Ember of Ruin
desc: +45% damage while below 40% health. Umbra-Rex approves of your choices.

name: Coin of the Brink
desc: +60% damage below 30% health, and 30 less health to get you there sooner.

name: Opening Verse
desc: +45% damage to enemies at full health. Make an entrance.

name: Titanbreaker Wedge
desc: +60% damage to elites and bosses, at the expense of the small fry.

name: Crooked Knucklebone
desc: Crits come often and land softer. The bones are crooked in your favour.

name: Headsman's Hood
desc: +90% crit damage. Take your time. Aim for the neck.

name: Razorwake
desc: Projectiles leave a wake of razor-light that cuts whatever crosses it.

name: Tarpit Heart
desc: Impacts leave pitch pools that hold the horde fast.

name: Gyrestone
desc: Every blast, well, pool and burst you make grows by a third.

name: Cindertread
mods: DashNova(radius: 2.0, damage: 20.0, element: Flame, status: Burn)
desc: Every dash kicks up a burst of burning cinders.

name: Vitriolcore
mods: Element(Plague); Style(Globe); Explode(radius: 1.5, damage: 0.4); Puddle(radius: 1.3, duration: 2.5, dps: 0.2); ProjectileSpeed(0.8)
desc: Alchemical globes that shatter, splash and linger. Vex's favourite solvent.

name: Verdictcore
mods: Element(Radiant); Style(Slug); DamageVsStatus(status: Mark, mult: 1.3); Knockback(1.2)
desc: Radiant slugs that strike the Marked like a final ruling.

name: Unmadecore
mods: Element(Void); Style(Shard); Fork(count: 2, angle: 90.0, damage: 0.5); ApplyStatus(status: Curse, chance: 0.2, stacks: 1, duration: 3.0)
desc: A splinter pried from the Unmaking. It will not stay one thing for long.

name: Split Carom
mods: Ricochet(bounces: 1, range: 5.0); Fork(count: 2, angle: 30.0, damage: 0.4); Damage(0.8)
desc: Bounces once, then splits. Geometry weeps.

name: Packhunt Volley
desc: Shots run as a pack: they spread, circle and go for the throat.

name: Chorus Lattice
desc: Every other shot is sung back by a choir that died with its gods.

name: Bell of the Last Chorus
desc: It rings for gods who are not coming back. Every fourth shot rings with it.

name: Reddeath Alembic
desc: Distils the recently dead into something far more useful: bombs.

name: Huntmother's Fang
mods: ApplyStatus(status: Bleed, chance: 0.35, stacks: 2, duration: 3.0); DamageVsElites(1.15)
desc: A fang from something that hunted gods. It still knows the big ones.

name: Heir's Oath
mods: MaxShield(35.0); ApplyStatus(status: Mark, chance: 0.2, stacks: 1, duration: 4.0)
desc: An oath of law: shield the faithful, mark the guilty.
